zh: 我的症状是三天前开始的：喉咙痛、流鼻涕。
en: My {symptoms} started three days ago: a sore throat and a runny nose.

zh: 医生给我开了一张抗生素的处方。
en: The doctor wrote me a {prescription} for antibiotics.

zh: 你有什么食物过敏吗？
en: Do you have any food {allergies}?

zh: 橄榄球赛之后，他腿上全是淤青。
en: His legs were covered in {bruises} after the rugby game.

zh: 我踢足球时扭伤了脚踝。
en: I twisted my {ankle} playing football.

zh: 拐角那家药店开到晚上九点。
en: The {pharmacy|chemist} on the corner is open until nine.

zh: 我想预约看医生。
en: I'd like to make an {appointment} to see the doctor.

zh: 她发高烧，全身都疼。
en: She has a high {fever|temperature} and she aches all over.

zh: 婴儿在出生后的第一年要打好几种疫苗。
en: Babies are given several {vaccines|vaccinations|immunisations|immunizations|jabs|shots} in their first year.

zh: 他下周要做膝盖手术。
en: He's having knee {surgery} next week.

zh: 每天要刷两次牙。
en: Brush your {teeth} twice a day.

zh: 我咳嗽已经两个星期了，一直不见好。
en: I've had this {cough} for two weeks and it won't go away.

zh: 我头疼得厉害，得躺一会儿。
en: I have a terrible {headache} and I need to lie down.

zh: 我的后腰一阵剧痛。
en: I have a sharp {pain} in my lower back.

zh: 这个药每天饭后吃三次。
en: Take this {medicine|medication} three times a day after meals.

zh: 睡前用水送服两片药片。
en: Take two {tablets|pills} with water before bed.

zh: 因为肩膀受伤，他整个赛季都没上场。
en: He missed the whole season because of a shoulder {injury}.

zh: 护士先把伤口清洗干净，然后才缝合。
en: The nurse cleaned the {wound|cut} before stitching it up.

zh: 她在我的胳膊上缠了一条绷带。
en: She wrapped a {bandage} around my arm.

zh: 我把手割破了，缝了五针。
en: I cut my hand open and needed five {stitches}.

zh: 用了新肥皂以后，我胳膊上起了又红又痒的皮疹。
en: I got a red, itchy {rash} on my arm after using the new soap.

zh: 你需要用抗生素来治好耳朵的感染。
en: You'll need antibiotics to clear up the ear {infection}.

zh: 医生们花了好几个月才得出诊断结果。
en: It took the doctors months to reach a {diagnosis}.

zh: 她对这种治疗的反应很好。
en: She's responding well to the {treatment}.

zh: 医院没有足够的床位接收新病人。
en: The hospital doesn't have enough beds for new {patients}.

zh: 病房里的护士们对我妈妈特别好。
en: The {nurses} on the ward were so kind to my mum.

zh: 给我膝盖开刀的外科医生说手术很顺利。
en: The {surgeon} who operated on my knee said it went well.

zh: 护士抽了一点血去化验。
en: The nurse took some {blood} for testing.

zh: 我的血压有点高，所以我在少吃盐。
en: My blood {pressure} is a bit high, so I'm cutting down on salt.

zh: 整天坐在办公桌前，我的脖子和肩膀都僵了。
en: My neck and {shoulders} are stiff from sitting at a desk all day.

zh: 我下楼梯的时候两个膝盖都疼。
en: Both my {knees} hurt when I go down stairs.

zh: 我肠胃不舒服，可能是吃海鲜吃坏了肚子。
en: I've got an upset {stomach|tummy}; I think it was the seafood.

zh: 我喉咙痛，几乎说不出话。
en: I've got a sore {throat} and I can barely talk.

zh: 吸烟会损害你的肺。
en: Smoking damages your {lungs}.

zh: 她从自行车上摔下来，摔断了手腕。
en: She broke her {wrist} when she fell off her bike.

zh: 我每六个月去牙医那里做一次检查。
en: I go to the dentist for a {check-up|checkup} every six months.

zh: 我还在等验血的结果。
en: I'm still waiting for my blood test {results}.

zh: 服药不要超过建议的剂量。
en: Don't take more than the recommended {dose|dosage}.

zh: 这种药的副作用包括头晕和口干。
en: The side {effects} of this drug include dizziness and a dry mouth.

zh: 我们祝你早日康复。
en: We wish you a speedy {recovery}.

zh: 他有心脏方面的疾病，不能做剧烈运动。
en: He has a heart {condition|problem}, so he can't do heavy exercise.

zh: 他在街上晕倒了，有人叫了救护车。
en: He collapsed in the street and someone called an {ambulance}.

zh: 办公室一半的人都得了流感请病假了。
en: Half the office is off sick with the {flu}.

zh: 我被孩子传染了感冒。
en: I caught a {cold} from my kids.

zh: 她失眠很多年了，每晚很少能睡超过四个小时。
en: She has suffered from {insomnia} for years and rarely sleeps more than four hours a night.

zh: 他摔断腿以后一直拄着拐杖。
en: He's been on {crutches} since he broke his leg.

zh: 我的家庭医生把我转给了一位皮肤科专科医生。
en: My GP referred me to a skin {specialist}.

zh: 我得配一副新眼镜了，菜单上的字都看不清。
en: I need new {glasses}; I can't even read the menu.

zh: 昨天健身之后，我的肌肉很酸痛。
en: My {muscles} are sore after yesterday's workout.

zh: 我牙疼，吃了几片止痛药。
en: I took some {painkillers} for my toothache.
